question: As notified in April 2025, how many new species of Sericinae scarab beetles from the biodiversity-rich regions of India were discovered by Zoological Survey of India in collaboration with Germany’s Museum A. Koenig?
solution:
The correct answer is __**6**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The discovery of **six new species** of Sericinae scarab beetles was announced in **April 2025**.
 
• This discovery was made by the **Zoological Survey of India (ZSI)** in collaboration with **Germany’s Museum A. Koenig**.
 
• The newly discovered species were found in the **biodiversity-rich regions of India**, which include areas known for their high ecological diversity and unique habitats.
 
• These beetles belong to the subfamily **Sericinae**, which is part of the scarab beetle family (Scarabaeidae).
 
• The discovery highlights the importance of collaborative efforts in documenting biodiversity and conserving it for future generations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sericinae Scarab Beetles:**

 
 
• The subfamily Sericinae is part of the Scarabaeidae family, which contains a wide variety of beetles commonly known as scarabs.
 
• These beetles are known for their shiny, metallic appearance and are often found in soil, feeding on organic matter.
 
• Their ecological role includes helping in the decomposition of organic material and nutrient recycling.
 
 
 
• **Zoological Survey of India (ZSI):**
 
 
• The ZSI was established in **1916** to promote the survey, exploration, and research on the fauna of India.
 
• It is headquartered in **Kolkata** and functions under the Ministry of Environment, Forest, and Climate Change.
 
• The ZSI is instrumental in documenting India’s biodiversity and plays a key role in conservation strategies.
 
 
 
• **Collaboration with Museum A. Koenig:**
 
 
• Germany’s Museum A. Koenig is a renowned institution for zoological research and houses vast collections of animal specimens.
 
• The collaboration signifies the importance of international partnerships in advancing scientific knowledge and biodiversity conservation.
 
 
 
• **Biodiversity-rich regions of India:**
 
 
• India is one of the **megadiverse countries**, hosting a significant portion of the world’s flora and fauna.
 
• Regions such as the **Western Ghats, Eastern Himalayas, and Northeast India** are known for their rich biodiversity and endemic species.
 
• These areas are crucial for ecological research and conservation efforts.
